claim_level: speculative band under stated assumptions; NOT an identification

prefill_angle.method: N_active <= MFU * peak * S / (2 * R); R from the measured marginal prefill slope

assumptions.concurrent_streams_B: 1 (conservative: batching with other tenants only lowers the per-stream bound)
assumptions.regime: compute-bound batched prefill (165k tok/s marginal is far above memory-bound decode rates)

prefill_angle.reading: Any architecture - dense or MoE - serving this marginal prefill rate on 1-4 modern accelerators at ordinary efficiency has an ACTIVE footprint of roughly 0.2-2.7B parameters; multi-tenant sharing, not less, is the honest direction of error.

capability_angle.basis: Jev's direct-answer MMLU-Pro/GPQA sit at/above the no-thinking Claude 3.7 row and beside Qwen 3.5 9B's reasoning-protocol scores; a 2025-era ~9B-class instruct model is the nearest published analog, with a 4-14B dense-equivalent band to absorb protocol mismatch and vintage effects. HLE 21.9% and ARC-AGI-2 0/120 exact cap it far below frontier sizes.
caveats: capability bands are loose: hundreds of models share this band
distillation shifts capability-per-parameter upward (a distilled 1-4B can sit in this band on knowledge MCQs)
MoE models are sized by ACTIVE parameters in this band too

conventions_note: 2N FLOPs/token counts weight matmuls only; attention adds ~2*L*d_model per token per layer, which at <=29k context and typical small-model widths is <15% of the total - inside the assumption ranges.

reconciliation.tension: prefill-throughput angle: <= 0.2-2.7B ACTIVE parameters (B=1 conservative). capability angle: 4-14B dense-equivalent. The two overlap only at the top of the throughput band and the bottom of the capability band.

readings_that_reconcile_both.statement: active ~0.2-2.7B with a larger total (e.g. a ~15-40B-total MoE at 10-20% activation) satisfies the throughput bound while carrying 9B-class knowledge
readings_that_reconcile_both.independent_evidence: none - the API cannot see expert structure (ARCHITECTURE-ANALYSIS.md sec.5)

readings_that_reconcile_both.statement: fp8/int4 weights+math raise effective peak 2-4x, moving the throughput band to ~0.4-10B active; a dense 4-8B served at int4 fits both angles
readings_that_reconcile_both.independent_evidence: none directly; the $0.042/M price is consistent with aggressive cost engineering

readings_that_reconcile_both.statement: a distilled 1-4B dense model can reach the BOTTOM of the 4-14B capability band on knowledge MCQs (teacher labels transfer knowledge, not reasoning) - and Jev's recognition>>production asymmetry is exactly that shape
readings_that_reconcile_both.independent_evidence: weak/indirect: generation tax (83.1% MCQ vs 13.6% digit read-out), HLE near floor, brand prior (ARCHITECTURE-ANALYSIS.md sec.6)

readings_that_reconcile_both.reading: throughput band is soft at the top
readings_that_reconcile_both.statement: B>1 amortization, higher MFU, or larger shards than assumed push the active bound up toward 4B
readings_that_reconcile_both.independent_evidence: ground rule 4 itself: marginal ms under shared batching is a scheduling artifact

reconciliation.converged_statement: Two-sided best guess: ACTIVE parameters of order 0.5-4B (throughput bound at the top under conservative assumptions, capability band at the bottom once distillation/MoE are admitted); TOTAL parameters unconstrained (MoE would hide them). If forced to one dense-equivalent number: order 1-9B, i.e. a 2025-era small model - NOT a parameter claim from latency alone (ground rule 4 is respected: the throughput angle is an explicit-assumptions bound, not a slope-to-size conversion).
what_would_tighten_it: a matched-protocol capability evaluation (removes band looseness)
the staged P2 option-cost probe at large K under load (bounds per-token marginal compute more tightly)
